decision.section: Iterate — fix: per-journey E2E coverage gate
decision.title: Shared per-journey E2E coverage oracle
decision.context: FR-01.06 #6b was deferred because the shared verifier could not import the test plugin matcher without violating ADR-045.
decision.decision: Move reusable journey parsing and matching to shared/scripts/lib and call it from the shared test gate; retain plugin shims for compatibility.
decision.consequences: Every planned journey needs a matching local spec; greenfield blocks and brownfield creates durable non-blocking follow-up work.
decision.rationale: A shared oracle makes the existing criterion-14 behavior authoritative at the gate.
decision.rejected: A plugin-private import violates ADR-045; retaining the existence-only floor preserves the known false-positive.

changelog.bullet: Require every planned user journey to match a local E2E spec instead of accepting an arbitrary spec file.

event_extras.summary: The test gate now checks every planned user journey against a matching browser test.
